policy.name: random
policy.description: Uniform random torques within the hand limits on every reachable door joint (resampled at 20 Hz) and a random-walk base velocity.

run.label: baseline, 10-core Apple Silicon, MuJoCo 3.12

scenarios.name: open_and_traverse
scenarios.description: Start in the start zone, reach the handle, unlatch, open and walk through the door plane to the goal zone.

scenarios.name: open_then_close
scenarios.description: Open, walk through, then close the door behind you (latched if the door has a latch).

scenarios.name: close_only
scenarios.description: The door starts open; close it (and latch it) without slamming.

scenarios.name: unlock_and_traverse
scenarios.description: The door is locked but releasable from the robot's side (thumbturn, keypad code, slide bolt, badge, REX ...): release the lock, open and walk through.

scenarios.name: locked_recognize
scenarios.description: The door is locked with no release on the robot's side: probe, recognise the lock, declare it (env.declare_locked()) and stop without damage.

run.command: /Users/adamraudonis/Desktop/Projects/DoorBench/.claude/worktrees/agent-af2157c1b35724e6c/doorbench/cli.py benchmark run --policy random --suite core --doors all --seeds 3 --workers 3 --label baseline, 10-core Apple Silicon, MuJoCo 3.12 --out results/random.json
